channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: BBC News
channel.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
channel.desc: Matt Tebbutt serves up a feast of global flavours from favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Mike Reid serves up a classic Parisian bistro dish of steak frites with a traditional Parisian sauce, while Donal Skehan and Donna Hay whip up a light and fluffy gnocchi (or gnudi) with a fresh cherry tomato and ricotta sauce.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
channel.desc: Eva marvels at the sheer beauty of Provence as it continues to rewrite the rules of French cuisine.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Ipcress File
channel.desc: Agent Harry Palmer is assigned to investigate a bizarre brain drain among scientists, and finds himself embroiled in a world of espionage where nobody can be trusted and nothing is what it seems.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: Claire Rawle and Thomas Plant visit Leicester's De Montfort Hall and Paul Martin discovers a collection of Picasso ceramics put together by a legend in his own right, Lord Richard Attenborough.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: National treasure Moira Stuart and star of stage and screen Aled Jones go head-to-head in a battle of antiques in Kent. Swapping the studio for the road, they cruise around in an all-electric Porsche 911. Helping hands on this trip are antique gurus David Harper and Serhat Ahmet. Moira shocks and surprises David with her eclectic, unorthodox choices and haggling tactics, while Aled and Serhat find common ground with sport and music.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
channel.desc: Eva enjoys Bordeaux's world-famous wines and its fresh produce and masterful Bordelaise sauces.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Pilgrimage
channel.desc: The pilgrims start just outside Eryri National Park and head west towards the Llyn Peninsula and the village of Y Fron in the famous North Wales slate landscape. They have a tough day of hill walking in the rain ahead of them.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
channel.desc: Simon Reeve treks and canoes through Canada's frozen Yukon Territory, meeting resilient locals who brave the wilderness and searching for majestic grizzly bears.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.desc: Jools Holland brings together hot, legendary and undiscovered artists for live studio performances, interviews and musical magic.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Question Time
channel.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Saving Lives at Sea
channel.desc: In Watergate Bay, one of Cornwall's surfing hotspots, two teenage boys are caught in one of the beach's notorious rip currents.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: This Is BBC TWO
channel.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: Indulge in a splash of seaside nostalgia with host Caroine Hawley and two more teams of antiques hunters. In Bristol, Caroline visits the Martin Parr Foundation to view a genre-defining exhibition by the late photographer Martin Parr CBE. It's 40 years since Parr produced his iconic collection of images of working-class family holidays in the Merseyside resort of New Brighton.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Great House Revival
channel.desc: Hugh Wallace meets architects Rob and Alfonso who have a precise budget to revive their historic brick terraced house in Dublin.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Mark Chapman presents highlights of three Premier League games as well as September's Goal of the Month. Manchester City face Liverpool in a highly charged fixture at Anfield, newly promoted Hull City are looking to continue their impressive start to the season at home to unbeaten Everton, and Nottingham Forest travel to Crystal Palace, who are so far without a win in the Premier League.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

Among the discoveries unearthed are a badly damaged painting once thrown on a skip and now valued at between ?20,000 and ?30,000, a memento from Laurel and Hardy, and a mug bearing Henry Sandon's spitting image.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Flog It!

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: The oil palm is a remarkable tree, with an incredibly diverse fruit that can be used for many different things - from shampoo and soap to toothpaste, crisps and chocolate. Unfortunately, the spread of this remarkable plant is leading to the destruction of the rainforests, particularly in Borneo and Sumatra. So what can we do? Firstly, learn where your food is coming from. Pay attention to the labels and look out for sustainable palm oil. We can?t get rid of palm oil altogether as it is in countless products, and many of the alternatives would be worse. But there are different ways of making palm oil, some of which will not completely destroy the forests. The next thing you could do is buy some forest for yourself. It is possible to fundraise, to get money to purchase a piece of perfect rainforest and protect it. So why not see if you can wash cars, and buy a piece of forest the size of your classroom, the size of your assembly hall, possibly even the size of your school. Finally, think about how you use wood and paper. Make sure you recycle and be sure to think about your impact on the world in every single thing you do. If we don?t, then rainforests could be condemned to history.

channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Deadly 60
channel.desc: It?s estimated that as many as 250 million sharks are taken from the world?s oceans every single year. Around 73 million of those are taken purely for their fins which are used in shark fin soup, with the rest of the body wasted. This fishing is causing the possibility of extinction for sharks - so, what can we do? First of all, learn about the fish you eat. Fish such as tuna and swordfish are caught with a very high bycatch of shark, which means sharks are caught accidentally when fishing for species. Look for sustainably caught fis, and if in doubt stay clear of it. Be aware of the things that are sold in your local fish and chip shop, as often things that are labelled as huss or rock salmon could actually be shark. And learn to love sharks! Having people understand that sharks are not the menacing, man-eating monsters they are made out to be is so important. Perhaps dream of diving with sharks yourself one day. With our help, sharks can survive into the future.

channel.desc: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup. Madame Gazelle is teaching the children fun games to play with paper.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Peppa Pig
channel.desc: Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
channel.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
channel.desc: The visitors land on the Moon and begin to explore. They meet some friendly aliens and have fun making sandcastles and sharing their picnic.

channel.name: Nick Jr UK
